reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my first question, is it really tested. At $24.99 with the money-back guarantee I can try one box without much risk.
objection: Made in China makes me want to open the report and check that the batch number really matches. And $25 is still a lot when I'm watching every dollar.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code report did not match the batch number on the box, or the lab could not be found, I would pass.
